correctness.rationale: For all positive rates the nine entries are exact cubic polynomials. Forward entries stay positive because the quadratic discriminant is strictly negative. Reverse entries have unique cutoff H=3/S. The slowest diagonal is G(h) at the maximum rate by strict decrease of r. On [0,H], a Bernstein representation with its first three coefficients strictly positive yields positivity if Phi>=0, and after substitution u=t/(1-t) a one-sign-change cubic yields exactly one root if Phi<0. No positivity recovers beyond H. The exact one-rate phase polynomial and strict improvement over 1/M follow by substitution and continuity. 11797 exact rational assertions over 343 integer rate triples corroborate but do not prove the universal result.

value.rationale: The three-state directed cycle is the minimal closed unidirectional Markov circulation, and arbitrary unequal positive jump rates form a natural full three-parameter family. This result gives a sharp actionable maximum end-step preserving stochasticity, a mathematically explicit reverse/diagonal failure mechanism and a sharp rate-imbalance transition, and proves a strict improvement beyond universal SSP bounds for every unequal-rate triple. It is a complete classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter substitution.
